description: Releases a rollback may return to, and the evidence that they served real work (I8 slice 6). infra/rollout/known-good.py checks a candidate against its own tree (preparation loop, migrations, config names) and this record; a candidate comes from here and its release bundle, never from a backup directory alone (F7: the only install backup on the box holds 27af05a, which cannot complete a job). Append entries; never rewrite one - a release that stops qualifying gets a new entry with known_good false and the reason.

releases.reason: no preparation loop (PREP-WORKER landed after it): accepts video jobs it can never prepare; its own commit says the pilot cannot serve until the loop lands

releases.served: second pilot release, 2026-09-24: W12 smoke 15/15, text and video jobs settled with engine-exact counts; E4B run1/run2; E1B through the public edge
releases.caveat: intake close-on-refusal ReadErrors under an 8-burst (fixed in bda1586); LARGE_BODY_LIMIT=8 is not in its env

schema_proof.result: 4226315: its own tests/d (26 suites, 384 passed, 13 SHAPE cases skipped by name, 5 xfailed) + the result-read probe PASS on 0001-0025, on plain PostgreSQL + shim AND on the Supabase image; migrate.py history check PASS on both
schema_proof.candidate: 9e4e34ca (0001-0023 as proven at 0023, 0024 + 0025 from D10-MERGE-2); supersedes the through-0023 proof (KNOWN-GOOD-PROOF-aab4b41), rerun whole
schema_proof.shape_added: 0024/0025: 3 browser-path cases (an unverified owner/consumer creating a key in the browser, which 0024 refuses by design; the enumerated browser surface, which 0025 grows) - not the old runtime's SQL; infrx_runtime grants unchanged 0023->0025
